_comment_exclude_repos: Repositories ignored when counting languages. Use this to keep tutorial/bootcamp code from dominating the chart. Names are case-insensitive.
_comment_exclude_languages: Languages never shown in the chart, e.g. generated or vendored code.
_comment_max_languages: How many languages to list before the rest are folded into 'Other'.
_comment_tiles: Which numbers appear on the overview card, in order, up to six. Available: public_repos, stars, forks, followers, languages, years.
_comment_downloads_card: Release-asset downloads card: 'language' groups them by each repository's main language, 'repository' by the repository itself, 'off' disables the card. The card and its README reference disappear automatically when there are no downloads at all.
_comment_downloads_min_total: The card stays hidden until release downloads reach this number, then appears on its own. A card announcing a couple of downloads says less than no card. Set it to 1 to show the card as soon as there is any download at all.
_comment_recent_count: How many recently pushed repositories to list in the README.
_comment_recent_skip: Repositories never listed in the README 'recent work' section.
